get.description: Checks that the HTTP process can answer.

200.description: The API process is responding. Empty body.

get.description: Checks PostgreSQL and calls the current worker through Restate. The worker performs an authenticated empty issuer lookup. Read-only clients can probe /health/reads.

200.description: Database, command registration, worker, and issuer are available.

503.description: At least one required command dependency is unavailable.

get.description: Four Prometheus text counters track accepted submissions (including replays), admission throttles, dependency failures and successful case reads (including lists). They reset when this API process restarts.

post.description: A product credential selects the policy by use_case. On a loan for an existing wallet customer, send the same subject_ref and omit evidence to evaluate eligible prior observations.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable per logical command. Replay its original body and key after an uncertain result.

get.description: Returns a stable page of cases and the total matching the same filters. Product credentials see their own cases. Observer and reviewer reads use their configured scopes.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive creation time. Defaults to seven days before the end.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive creation time. Defaults to now. Maximum window is 366 days.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: One product within the authenticated grant.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of case or subject reference.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Creation time, then case ID for ties.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Maximum supported offset is 10,000.

post.description: Use an issuer reference bound to the institution and subject. A correction needs new evidence. The case ID stays the same.

get.description: Requires the assigned institution and product reviewer role. Checks with observations include their original provider, operation, evidence reference, and revision.

post.description: The assigned reviewer supplies the current screening operation ID, decision, investigation reference and reason. An outdated operation returns 409.

get.description: Reads public, newest-first revision snapshots within the same case scope.

parameters.name: before_version
parameters.description: Exclusive cursor; omit for the newest revisions.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive revision recording time. Maximum bounded window is 366 days.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive revision recording time. Omit both bounds to include all history.

get.description: The owning product can inspect active synthetic checks, original operation IDs and Restate invocation links.

post.description: Only the owning product can answer a pending local synthetic check. Resending the same outcome for the same operation is safe. A conflicting response or stale operation returns 409. Common choices are demo:pass, demo:review, and demo:unavailable. Document also supports demo:expired and demo:threshold, face adds demo:threshold, address adds demo:stale and demo:threshold, and sanctions adds demo:hit and demo:inconclusive.

parameters.name: operation_id
parameters.description: Exact operation ID for the current check.

callerBearer.description: Service credential for the authorized product, reviewer or institution observer.

webhookBearer.description: The relay sends the configured WEBHOOK_TOKEN to the receiver as a bearer token.

ProductCaseId.description: Opaque full case ID returned by the service.

ProductReference.description: Opaque nonblank reference of up to 256 UTF-8 bytes. Control characters are excluded.

ProductEvidence.description: References issued for this institution and subject. Face captures are bound to the current document portrait. The service derives the screening identity.

operation_id.description: Current operation ID from the reviewer handoff.

reason.description: Investigator's reason, 1–512 Unicode code points. Line feeds are allowed. The API normalizes CRLF to LF. Other control characters and blank-only reasons are invalid.

received_at.description: Worker receipt time, when recorded. Earlier records may omit this field.

interactive.description: This check uses a local provider callback.

received_at.description: Worker receipt time, when recorded. Earlier records may omit this field.

alerts.description: Late screening alerts with provider provenance from the originally dispatched operation when available.

Product400.description: Missing or invalid Idempotency-Key or malformed JSON.

Product403.description: Role, product use case, or grant denied.

Product409.description: A different payload reused an existing key (idempotency_key_reused), the screening operation changed (stale_operation), the case closed (case_already_decided), or the current state disallows the command (invalid_case_state).

Product422.description: Invalid request, evidence binding or policy input.

Product429.description: Caller admission quota reached. Wait before replaying the same command.

ProductAccepted.description: Command accepted. Read the case at the relative Location URL. A replay with the same key and body returns the same case ID.

InvalidQuery.description: The query contains an invalid filter, date range, cursor or pagination value. The message identifies the correction.
